candidates.change_summary: Replace the selfdestruct target so contract self-destructs to the owner stored in smartfix_owner instead of the caller, changing who receives remaining funds.
Remove the require check so anyone can call and self-destruct the contract, changing whether call succeeds and who can trigger destruction.
Invert the require condition so only non-owner callers can trigger the self-destruct, altering which callers succeed and thus observable behavior.
Change the self-destruct recipient to the zero address (address(0)), which will burn funds and changes post-call transfer behavior.
